integrity: Both source quasi-cyclic modules are reconstructed exactly over F_5. The dual is obtained by exact modular nullspace computation, and all 5^8 words on each security side are exhaustively enumerated to verify the full common Hamming histogram and the separating symbol-composition count.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to Example 6.1 and proves inequivalence under coordinate permutations only; monomial equivalence is not assessed. It does not claim a new general existence theorem for inequivalent quasi-cyclic LCPs.
title: Hamming-isospectral but permutation-inequivalent sides of an optimal quasi-cyclic LCP
